spans.s: फण् vt. 1P (pp. फणित) 1. To go, to go about, to move, रुरुजुर्भ्रेजिरे फेणुर्बहुधा हरिराक्षसाः Bt.xiv.78; 2. to produce easily.
फण m. The expanded hood of a cobra, विप्रकृतः पन्नगः फणं कुरुते Sak.vi., R.xiii.12, K.S.vi.68.
फणा f. The expanded hood of a serpent, तत्फणामंडलोदंचिर्मणिद्योविग्रहम् R.x.7, or पर्यंकीकृतनागनायकफणाश्रेणीमणीनां गणे Git.G.xii. (For compounds, See under फण.)
फण-कर m. a snake.
फण-धर m. 1. a snake; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
फण-भृत् m. a snake.
फण-मणि m. a jewel supposed to be found in the hood of a snake.
फण-मंडल n. the rounded hood of a serpent, करालफणमंडलम् R.xii.98.

फणिन् m. 1. The hooded serpent, फणी मयूरस्य तले निषीदति Rt.i.13, R.xvi.17, K.S.iii.21; 2. an epithet of Rāhu; 3. an epithet of Pantanjali, the author of the Mahābhāshya on Pāṇini’s sūtras, फणिभाषितभाष्यफक्किका Na.ii.95, (whether he is identical with the author of the Yogasūtra is not known).
फणिन्-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa; 2. an epithet of Ananta, a serpent-chief; 3. an epithet of Patanjali.
फणिन्-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. 1. an epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa; 2. an epithet of Ananta, a serpent-chief; 3. an epithet of Patanjali.
फणिन्-खेल m. a quail.
फणिन्-तल्पग m. an epithet of Viṣṇu whose bed is the serpent Śeṣa.
फणिन्-पति m. 1. an epithet of Śeṣa; 2. of Vāsuki; 3. of Patanjali, फणिपतिदृशा शब्दशास्त्रे विचारः Vikr.Ch.xviii.82.
फणिन्-प्रिय m. wind.
फणिन्-फेन m. opium.
फणिन्-भाष्य n. Mahābhāshya (the commentary of Patanjali on Pāṇinis sūtras).
फणिन्-भुज् m. 1. a peacock; 2. an epithet of Garuḍa.
फणि f. Molasses.
फणित n. Molasses.
